description: This file is a test script for Git's revision list ('git rev-list') command, specifically testing the '--bisect' and related options. It sets up various Git commits and tags to simulate different histories and performs assertions to verify correct behavior of the bisect functionality within Git.

methods.name: test_bisection_diff
methods.description: Performs a Git revision list bisect test with specified maximum difference and options, verifying that the size of the bisected list is within the expected margin.

methods.name: test_sequence
methods.description: Runs a sequence of bisect tests on various commit points to verify the correct functionality of '--bisect' in different scenarios.
